capabilities: Chat with AI models in a side panel with streaming output
Ask questions about selected text via a right-click popover
Insert results at the cursor or overwrite the selection
Attach notes to a chat using [[ suggestions
Manage multiple models with separate API keys and usage stats
extras: README is bilingual (Chinese and English); the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: The author says the plugin exists purely for minimal, no-frills AI use: "没有什么科技含量，单纯为极简使用AI".
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI chat, and asking about a piece of selected text normally means leaving the editor or copying it into another app.

relations.evidence: Gemini: model name e.g. gemini-3.5-flash; API key from Google AI Studio
DeepSeek: model name e.g. deepseek-chat / deepseek-reasoner; API key from DeepSeek Open Platform
Optional base URL for gateway/proxy (e.g. OpenRouter, one-api)

requires.name: model provider API key (Google AI Studio, DeepSeek, or proxy gateway)
provider account to obtain API keys

summary: AI assistant plugin with a side-panel chat and a selection popover that answers questions about selected text and inserts or overwrites results.
